---
title: "Feedback"
description: "Share feedback, report an issue, or suggest an improvement."
sidebar: false
toc: false
css:
  - styles.css
  - feedback.css
---

```{=html}
<div class="fb-page">

  <div class="fb-intro">
    <span class="fb-eyebrow">HELP IMPROVE THIS SITE</span>

    <h2>Your experience matters.</h2>

    <p>
      Found something useful, spotted a problem, or have an idea?
      Share what worked and what could be better.
    </p>

    <ul class="fb-badges">
      <li>Contact details optional</li>
      <li>No account needed</li>
      <li>Only relevant details</li>
    </ul>
  </div>

  <div class="fb-layout">

    <div
      class="fb-aside"
      role="note"
      aria-label="Before you start"
    >
      <h2>A quick note</h2>

      <p>
        Fields marked “required” must be completed.
        Everything else is optional.
      </p>

      <p>
        Feedback is sent through FormSubmit to the site owner.
        Please do not include passwords, API keys, financial details,
        private client information, or sensitive logs.
      </p>

      <p>
        For evidence, share a safe, redacted link.
        File uploads are not enabled.
      </p>

      <p>
        Do not submit vulnerability details through this form.
        Use an agreed private security-reporting channel instead.
      </p>

      <p>
        Your entries are cleared only after submission is confirmed.
        If submission fails, they remain in the form.
      </p>
    </div>

    <form
      id="feedback-form"
      class="fb-form"
      action="https://formsubmit.co/hasnainfrnz@gmail.com"
      method="POST"
      aria-describedby="fb-status"
    >
      <input
        type="hidden"
        name="_subject"
        value="New website feedback — Danish297"
      >

      <p
        id="fb-status"
        class="fb-notice"
        role="status"
        aria-live="polite"
        aria-atomic="true"
      >
        Feedback is sent through FormSubmit to the site owner.
        Please do not include personal, confidential, or sensitive information.
      </p>

      <noscript>
        <p>
          JavaScript is required to enable this form.
          No submission is available without it.
        </p>
      </noscript>

      <fieldset id="fb-controls" disabled>
        <legend>1. What would you like to share?</legend>

        <div class="fb-field">
          <label for="fb-category">
            Feedback type (required)
          </label>

          <select
            id="fb-category"
            name="category"
            required
          >
            <option value="">Choose an option</option>
            <option value="general">General feedback</option>
            <option value="praise">Something I liked</option>
            <option value="suggestion">
              Improvement or feature suggestion
            </option>
            <option value="bug">Bug or technical issue</option>
            <option value="correction">
              Content correction or broken link
            </option>
            <option value="topic">Request a topic or tutorial</option>
            <option value="accessibility">Accessibility issue</option>
            <option value="privacy">
              Privacy concern (no sensitive details)
            </option>
            <option value="other">Something else</option>
          </select>
        </div>

        <div class="fb-field">
          <label for="fb-subject">
            Short summary (required)
          </label>

          <input
            id="fb-subject"
            name="subject"
            type="text"
            maxlength="160"
            placeholder="Briefly describe your feedback"
            required
          >
        </div>

        <div class="fb-field">
          <label for="fb-message">
            Tell me more (required)
          </label>

          <textarea
            id="fb-message"
            name="message"
            rows="5"
            maxlength="5000"
            placeholder="What worked well, what needs improvement, or what went wrong?"
            aria-describedby="fb-message-help"
            required
          ></textarea>

          <small id="fb-message-help">
            Maximum 5,000 characters.
          </small>
        </div>

        <div class="fb-field">
          <label for="fb-page_url">
            Page URL related to your feedback
          </label>

          <input
            id="fb-page_url"
            name="page_url"
            type="url"
            maxlength="2048"
            placeholder="[https://](https://)..."
          >
        </div>

        <details class="fb-details">
          <summary>Ratings and interests (optional)</summary>

          <div class="fb-grid">

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-overall">Overall experience</label>

              <select id="fb-overall" name="overall">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="1">1 — Very poor</option>
                <option value="2">2 — Poor</option>
                <option value="3">3 — Okay</option>
                <option value="4">4 — Good</option>
                <option value="5">5 — Excellent</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-usefulness">Content usefulness</label>

              <select id="fb-usefulness" name="usefulness">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="1">1 — Very poor</option>
                <option value="2">2 — Poor</option>
                <option value="3">3 — Okay</option>
                <option value="4">4 — Good</option>
                <option value="5">5 — Excellent</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-navigation">Ease of navigation</label>

              <select id="fb-navigation" name="navigation">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="1">1 — Very poor</option>
                <option value="2">2 — Poor</option>
                <option value="3">3 — Okay</option>
                <option value="4">4 — Good</option>
                <option value="5">5 — Excellent</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-speed">Loading speed</label>

              <select id="fb-speed" name="speed">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="1">1 — Very poor</option>
                <option value="2">2 — Poor</option>
                <option value="3">3 — Okay</option>
                <option value="4">4 — Good</option>
                <option value="5">5 — Excellent</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-design">Design and readability</label>

              <select id="fb-design" name="design">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="1">1 — Very poor</option>
                <option value="2">2 — Poor</option>
                <option value="3">3 — Okay</option>
                <option value="4">4 — Good</option>
                <option value="5">5 — Excellent</option>
              </select>
            </div>

          </div>

          <fieldset class="fb-topics">
            <legend>Topics you are interested in</legend>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="AI and local LLMs"
              >
              <span>AI and local LLMs</span>
            </label>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="Computer vision"
              >
              <span>Computer vision</span>
            </label>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="Oracle Database and EBS"
              >
              <span>Oracle Database and EBS</span>
            </label>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="Cloud technologies"
              >
              <span>Cloud technologies</span>
            </label>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="Kubernetes and OpenShift"
              >
              <span>Kubernetes and OpenShift</span>
            </label>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="Automation and scripting"
              >
              <span>Automation and scripting</span>
            </label>

            <label class="fb-check">
              <input
                type="checkbox"
                name="topics"
                value="Other"
              >
              <span>Other</span>
            </label>
          </fieldset>
        </details>

        <details class="fb-details">
          <summary>
            Issue details (for bugs, corrections, or accessibility problems)
          </summary>

          <div class="fb-field">
            <label for="fb-steps">
              Steps to reproduce the problem
            </label>

            <textarea
              id="fb-steps"
              name="steps"
              rows="5"
              maxlength="3000"
              aria-describedby="fb-steps-help"
            ></textarea>

            <small id="fb-steps-help">
              Maximum 3,000 characters.
            </small>
          </div>

          <div class="fb-field">
            <label for="fb-expected">What did you expect?</label>

            <textarea
              id="fb-expected"
              name="expected"
              rows="5"
              maxlength="2000"
              aria-describedby="fb-expected-help"
            ></textarea>

            <small id="fb-expected-help">
              Maximum 2,000 characters.
            </small>
          </div>

          <div class="fb-field">
            <label for="fb-actual">What actually happened?</label>

            <textarea
              id="fb-actual"
              name="actual"
              rows="5"
              maxlength="2000"
              aria-describedby="fb-actual-help"
            ></textarea>

            <small id="fb-actual-help">
              Maximum 2,000 characters.
            </small>
          </div>

          <div class="fb-grid">

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-impact">
                How much does this affect you?
              </label>

              <select id="fb-impact" name="impact">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="minor">Minor inconvenience</option>
                <option value="workaround">
                  Disruptive, but I have a workaround
                </option>
                <option value="blocked">
                  I cannot complete what I came to do
                </option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-frequency">
                How often does it happen?
              </label>

              <select id="fb-frequency" name="frequency">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="once">Once</option>
                <option value="sometimes">Sometimes</option>
                <option value="always">Every time</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-browser">Browser</label>

              <select id="fb-browser" name="browser">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="Safari">Safari</option>
                <option value="Microsoft Edge">Microsoft Edge</option>
                <option value="Google Chrome">Google Chrome</option>
                <option value="Mozilla Firefox">Mozilla Firefox</option>
                <option value="Opera">Opera</option>
                <option value="Other">Other</option>
                <option value="Not sure">Not sure</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-browser_version">Browser version</label>

              <input
                id="fb-browser_version"
                name="browser_version"
                type="text"
                maxlength="80"
              >
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-device">Device type</label>

              <select id="fb-device" name="device">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="desktop">Desktop</option>
                <option value="laptop">Laptop</option>
                <option value="tablet">Tablet</option>
                <option value="phone">Phone</option>
                <option value="other">Other / not sure</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-os">Operating system and version</label>

              <input
                id="fb-os"
                name="os"
                type="text"
                maxlength="120"
              >
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-theme">Site appearance</label>

              <select id="fb-theme" name="theme">
                <option value="">Choose an option</option>
                <option value="light">Light</option>
                <option value="dark">Dark</option>
                <option value="unknown">Not sure</option>
              </select>
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-assistive_technology">
                Assistive technology or zoom setting, if relevant
              </label>

              <input
                id="fb-assistive_technology"
                name="assistive_technology"
                type="text"
                maxlength="160"
              >
            </div>

          </div>

          <div class="fb-field">
            <label for="fb-evidence_url">
              Redacted screenshot or evidence URL
            </label>

            <input
              id="fb-evidence_url"
              name="evidence_url"
              type="url"
              maxlength="2048"
              aria-describedby="fb-evidence-help"
            >

            <small id="fb-evidence-help">
              Only share a link you are authorized to disclose.
              Review its sharing permissions first.
            </small>
          </div>
        </details>

        <details class="fb-details">
          <summary>Your details and follow-up (optional)</summary>

          <p>
            You can leave your name and email blank.
            An email address is needed only if you request a reply.
          </p>

          <div class="fb-grid">

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-name">Name or nickname</label>

              <input
                id="fb-name"
                name="name"
                type="text"
                maxlength="100"
                autocomplete="name"
              >
            </div>

            <div class="fb-field">
              <label for="fb-email">Email address</label>

              <input
                id="fb-email"
                name="email"
                type="email"
                maxlength="254"
                autocomplete="email"
                aria-describedby="fb-email-help"
              >

              <small id="fb-email-help">
                Required only when you select “I would like a reply.”
              </small>
            </div>

          </div>

          <label class="fb-check">
            <input
              id="fb-reply"
              type="checkbox"
              name="reply_requested"
              value="yes"
            >
            <span>I would like a reply about this feedback.</span>
          </label>
        </details>

        <label class="fb-check fb-ack">
          <input
            id="fb-ack"
            type="checkbox"
            name="acknowledgement"
            value="yes"
            required
          >

          <span>
            I have reviewed my message and have not included secrets
            or sensitive personal information. (required)
          </span>
        </label>

        <div class="fb-actions">
          <button
            id="fb-submit"
            type="submit"
            disabled
          >
            Send feedback
          </button>

          <span id="fb-send-note">
            Your entries are cleared only after submission is confirmed.
          </span>
        </div>

      </fieldset>
    </form>

  </div>
</div>

<script src="feedback.js" defer></script>
```
